page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance operates with a single thread per core configuration, ensuring predictable compute performance without hyper-threading resource sharing.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and the instance does not feature any integrated GPU hardware.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for compute-heavy workloads where memory density is secondary to raw processing power. This resource distribution offers qualitative cost efficiency by minimizing memory overhead expenses for CPU-bound tasks. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, application servers, and CI/CD pipelines.
